summary: RAG few-shot with 2 nearest gold exemplars
hypothesis: Injecting the 2 most similar gold exemplars as few-shot demonstrations should improve question quality — especially non-redundancy and coverage — because seeing worked examples of decision-critical unknowns gives the 3B a concrete pattern to follow at inference time.
technique: At runtime, 2 nearest non-dev gold exemplars are retrieved by word-overlap Jaccard similarity from a hard-coded pool of 12, then injected as few-shot demonstrations into the system prompt, followed by a single greedy FM call to generate the 7 questions.

stages.text: Fetch 2 nearest gold exemplars via Jaccard
Single FM call with few-shot demonstrations
